item.title: Incarico post-doc: Analysis of interactions between social movements and legacy media within the INTERFACED project. (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-06 Sociologia dei processi culturali e comunicativi

The INTERFACED project aims to understand how the multiple interfaces between citizens and representative institutions function in the post-pandemic context, assessing their capacity to include citizens in decision-making and governance processes. . To achieve these objectives, the project requires the application of state-of-the-art qualitative, quantitative, and computational research methods – such as journalistic frame analysis, protest event analysis, in-depth interviews, and social media analysis – which are characteristic of the academic field GSPS-06/A. The research is expected to result in the publication of scientific findings in leading international peer-reviewed journals.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 18:00
Institution: Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche, Roma
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-05 Sociologia generale

The Research Fellow will be assigned to conduct study and research activities in the following areas: ethics and integrity in research, methodologies and applications in the social sciences and in the cognitive and behavioral sciences. The Research Fellow will also be involved in the activities of the CNR’s Commission for Ethics and Integrity in Research, particularly in the process of issuing ethical clearance opinions for projects to be carried out at the Agency, and in the examination of cases of alleged research misconduct

item.title: RTT: Ca' Foscari University of Venice - 1 fixed-term tenure-track researcher in History and Institutions of Asia (Univ. VENEZIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 13:00
Institution: Univ. VENEZIA, Venezia
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-04 Storia internazionale e studi di area

The successful candidate will conduct research in Asian History and Institutions, focusing on the contemporary South Caucasus and Central Asia. The study will cover history, political-institutional evolution, and regional/international political dynamics, with a specific focus on energy and infrastructure (internal dynamics and external relations). The candidate is expected to enhance project-design capacity by identifying funding opportunities and submitting national and international research proposals.

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Epistemic Validation and Socio-Cultural Impact of Artificial Intelligence: From the Giordano Bruno Case Study to a Human-Centred Framework (Univ. NAPOLI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-17 12:00
Institution: Univ. NAPOLI, Naples
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-06 Sociologia dei processi culturali e comunicativi

The research activity aims to develop a model for the epistemic validation of Artificial Intelligence systems, using Giordano Bruno’s thought and works as a case study. The research will include the reconstruction and formalisation of epistemological categories related to body, mind, consciousness, identity and perception, also through knowledge representation tools. Empirical activities will also investigate human–AI interaction through interviews, focus groups and observation of interactions with digital systems

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Migration routes: agency, materiality and solidarity. A multisensorial approach. (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-06 Sociologia dei processi culturali e comunicativi

DEBMAT asks: how can we understand the structuring of migration routes beyond the present moment? The project addresses this through an innovative lens, examining the materiality of transit and its constitutive effect on the (re)production of migration routes, investigating the structures, infrastructures, and actors shaping routes across the Mediterranean at large.
